import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,json,hashlib,datetime
p=pathlib.Path.cwd();H=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();m=json.loads((p/'SHA256-MANIFEST.json').read_text());bad=[]
for n,v in m['files'].items():
 b=(p/n).read_bytes()
 if H(b)!=v['sha256'] or len(b)!=v['bytes']:bad.append(n)
assert not bad,bad
r=H((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes());assert r=='e0a352e8205afb1b2ba34d44df7628b39ebbda45589781fc34fdf9154b86ac44';assert (p/'reservation.sha256').read_text().split()[0]==r
k=json.loads((p/'keyedresults.json').read_text());assert len(k)==20 and set(k)==set(map(str,json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text())['ids']));assert all(v['credit']==0 for v in k.values())
for n in ['manifest_y.receipt.json','brief_write_x.receipt.json','bootstrap-receipt.json']:
 o=json.loads((p/n).read_text());print(n,'preserved',H((p/n).read_bytes()),'exit',o.get('exit','bootstrap-specific schema'))
utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();(p/'reservation-check-after-handback.json').write_text(json.dumps({'utc':utc,'sha256':r,'unchanged':True,'meaning':'terminal handback verification, no later mutation authorized'},indent=2))
(p/'MANIFEST-VERIFICATION.json').write_text(json.dumps({'utc':utc,'entries_verified':len(m['files']),'mismatches':bad,'manifest_sha256':H((p/'SHA256-MANIFEST.json').read_bytes()),'reservation_sha256':r,'exact20_zero_credit':True,'terminal_exclusions':m['explicit_terminal_self_exclusions'],'compliance':'FAIL: disclosed access retry and route GET-cap breach; mathematical source gaps remain, no survivor','all_prior_runner_children_reaped':True},indent=2))
print('VERIFIED',len(m['files']),'files;20 records;reservation unchanged;credit0;52/60 unchanged. No jobs outstanding.')
